sources.title: After being pushed out of Google, Timnit Gebru forms her own AI research institute DAIR

profile_text.body:
The Distributed AI Research Institute is a nonprofit founded in 2021 and headquartered in Oakland, California. It describes itself as an independent, globally distributed organization of academics, activists, and engineers conducting community-rooted research, and says its members believe in technology that benefits everyone.

On its own site the institute states that people want and deserve to see themselves reflected in technology, and that the suite of tools known as artificial intelligence can include thoughtful, supportive, and inclusive technologies that benefit communities. It also states that AI is seldom the solution and that its advance should not be treated as inevitable. The institute says it provides guidelines and frameworks to researchers and practitioners seeking to build and deploy AI systems without theft and exploitation. Its site also carries reflections from Kat, Nyalleng, and Raesetje on Deep Learning Indaba 2026, described there as an annual gathering in Lagos focused on building Africa's AI future.

The institute is not recorded as a party to any litigation, and no AI products are tracked under its name.
